source_scope_cautions: Figure 3 caption assigns ORA-S4 flow to upper 415 m, while section 2c describes upper-400-m means; no harmonised model-layer record admitted.
Reported seasonal amplitude is a branching-latitude quantity, not current width or whole-current length.

measurement_rules_to_carry_forward.rule: Declare branching-point definition and upstream current-core connectivity; do not choose an arbitrary velocity zero.
Keep surface and depth-specific or layer-averaged gates distinct, including reference level and source product.
Keep seasonal-cycle, interannual/filtered variation and estimation uncertainty as separate range types.
Do not convert branching latitude, coastal sampling-band width or a source seasonal amplitude into a current width or whole-current length.
A reported latitude and seasonal window do not define a longitude, route axis or monthly geometry; require compatible source fields before atlas measurement.

remaining_gates: Review identities and source terminology before canonical admission.
Acquire versioned fields with resolved layer/time, masks and coverage; reproduce regional gate diagnosis.
Source upstream gate and full axis separately; compare lengths only within a declared compatible scope.
Retain missing geometry, width and dimensions until evidence supports each.
